notes: Encoded ONLY from this brand's own page. Page-listed sister/similar brands (Airwell-Fedders, Wesper) are NOT claimed to share this serial system and no usesStylesOf is used.

styles.era: 12-character serials, 2 letters + 9 digits + 1 letter, month + year
styles.notes: Page positions 3rd & 4th character numerical digits = month, 5th & 6th character numerical digits = year (1-based), converted to [2,4] and [4,6].
